title: Maximize Distance to Closest Person
goal: Choose an empty seat maximizing its distance to the nearest occupied seat.
strategy: Leading and trailing gaps have one occupied boundary. Interior gaps have two, so the best possible minimum distance is half their endpoint spacing.
